release_locator: Opening press-release dateline, Toronto, ON, May 5, 2026; official research archive also dates May 5, 2026
population: English-speaking Canadian adults age 18+ with internet access; opt-in incentivized consumer panel
sample_design: Recruit until 1,005 readers; selective sampling on age, gender and geographical region. Publisher representativeness claim does not make this a probability sample.
recall_period: Last year / past 12 months; annual observation 2025
reader_definition: Report p.4 defines readers as people reading/listening to a book or part of a book at least once in the past year. The May 5 release blog describes eligibility as at least a few times per year; exact public questionnaire routing is not published. Retain this wording qualification.

Print.summary: Frequency of physical/print book reading in last year

Ebook.summary: Frequency of ebook reading in last year

Audiobook.summary: Frequency of audiobook listening,CD/tape/digital,in last year

format_locator: Printed p.25, PDF index 24; reach prose 93/71/57%; Never row 7/29/43%
format_measure: Readers reporting any reading/listening in that format; not format preference. Preferences 58/18/16% are a separate measure.
inference_restrictions: Do not treat as all-Canadian-adult reach
Do not construct survey-design CIs from the blanket ±3% publisher claim
Do not overwrite 2024 sample size or observations
Year-to-year differences are descriptive separate-panel estimates, not proven significant trends

genres.audio_comics_cells: Fiction dash and nonfiction blank; unavailable and excluded from audio questionnaire choices; never zero
